revision_history.reason: Add immutable cash-collateral term-set, order-quote causality and state-transition schema controls before any replay.
Add order-to-term route/account/scope/currency/effective-role assertions so obsolete or wrong-scope funding and collateral terms cannot pass reconciliation.
Add post-lockbox primary-holdout start-state manifests, conditional submission-path timestamps, and deterministic cash/collateral role applicability controls.
Add typed cash/margin/settlement ledger events and a contiguous order-transition-chain invariant so ledger reconciliation is machine-checkable.
Close nullable role-term escape paths, partial-fill terminal states, fee/tax provenance and currency reconciliation before any replay.

Add canonical frozen-run binding, endpoint-population proof, unitized position/cash/P&L reconciliation, immutable fill legs, dated typed broker/tax terms and prospective state/configuration coverage before any replay.
Repair endpoint a/s/e calculation semantics and the canonical execution-versus-settlement state matrix; add per-fill cumulative and remaining quantity audit fields.

purpose: Define normalized field names, keys, types, units, availability semantics and null handling for a future entitled replay package. It does not represent collected data or a data right.

common_rules.decimal_storage: Decimal string or fixed-point integer with declared scale; binary floating point is prohibited in frozen accounting outputs.
common_rules.currency: Record ISO currency and source unit for every monetary or price field; do not infer CNY solely from venue.
common_rules.missing_value_rule: No numeric sentinel is permitted. A null requires quality_status REJECTED or EXCEPTION and an exception record. Zero is valid only when the source explicitly reports zero.
common_rules.duplicate_rule: Duplicate table primary keys are rejected unless source_revision differs and the supersession relationship is recorded.
common_rules.coverage_rule: Expected row counts are generated from the frozen universe, lifecycle and trading calendar. Missing rows require a documented status rather than forward fill.
common_rules.frozen_run_binding_rule: Every run-dependent row must contain replay_run_id and replay_run_freeze_record_sha256. The pair is a foreign key to replay_run_freeze_record and is rejected unless the parent freeze_status is SIGNED and its canonical/freezing-contract/protocol/data-dictionary crosswalk fields, source cutoff, input manifest and policy hashes match their designated DAC/RP/document values byte-for-byte.

cross_table_validation_rules: Run binding is a composite foreign key: every row in every table listed by machine_validation_contract.run_dependent_table_ids must have replay_run_id and replay_run_freeze_record_sha256 exactly equal to its replay_run_freeze_record parent. The parent freeze_status must be SIGNED; every machine_validation_contract.frozen_run_crosswalk.required_parent_fields value and byte_equality_map relation, plus source_revision_cutoff, input_manifest_sha256 and every policy hash, binds that run byte-for-byte. Independent row hashes such as fill_hash_sha256, event_hash_sha256, component_hash_sha256 and membership hashes validate their own canonical row/set content and must never be required to equal replay_run_freeze_record_sha256. A missing, stale, duplicated-with-different-value, unresolved crosswalk or unsigned parent is INVALID.

Each SUBMITTED order, each REJECTED_PRE_SUBMISSION order whose route validation caused rejection, each reservation and each order-linked event maps to exactly one effective execution_broker_terms row by broker_route_terms_id/source revision, route, account, typed scope and effective range. broker_fee_term and tax_levy_term must match that route/account/scope/effective row; tax_levy_term must additionally match exactly one effective tax_jurisdiction composite key. A broad or stale scope, an out-of-range effective date, or a missing jurisdiction foreign key is INVALID.

Each quote-based order and each quote-based immutable execution_fill_ledger row maps to one execution_market_snapshot composite key: instrument_or_contract_id, quote_timestamp and quote_source_revision. For ORDER_TIME_QUOTE, quote_timestamp is no later than submitted_at. For FILL_TIME_QUOTE, quote_timestamp is no later than that fill_at, quote_depth_source_reference is present, and the fill cannot exceed the globally sequenced remaining capacity in machine_validation_contract.liquidity_capacity_consumption_contract. CONSERVATIVE_PROXY has its proxy ID, nonempty frozen capacity_partition_id, impact source trace and CONSERVATIVE_PARTITION side; it cannot masquerade as quote depth. NO_FILL_ONLY has zero fills. A later quote cannot price an earlier fill.

execution_fill_ledger is immutable: fill_sequence is contiguous per order; every fill has time, positive quantity/unit, cumulative_filled_quantity, remaining_submitted_quantity, price/currency, gross-notional/currency, evidence basis, typed capacity snapshot key, global capacity_consumption_sequence, capacity/depth/impact fields and fill_hash_sha256. machine_validation_contract.liquidity_capacity_consumption_contract requires all orders sharing that key to use one contiguous sequence, prior_consumed_quantity equal the sum of all earlier increments, a constant available quantity, and total increment no greater than available; two orders cannot each claim prior zero on the same depth. Per order, filled_quantity equals SUM(fill_quantity), execution_price equals the fill-quantity-weighted average in one declared execution_price_currency, fill_count equals row count, fill_set_sha256 equals the canonical ordered fill set and fill_capacity_set_sha256 equals the ordered capacity set. Each fill references exactly one execution_order_state_transition sequence whose timestamp equals fill_at and whose edge is SUBMITTED->PARTIAL/FILLED or PARTIAL->PARTIAL/FILLED; cumulative/remaining quantities and the parent residual disposition reconcile to that edge. No fill may occur after a terminal cancel, expiry, reject, failure, no-fill or partial terminal transition. Every fill-linked settlement, margin, trade-principal or fee/tax amount has one execution_fill_ledger_event_link row; event-link set hashes reconcile in both parent directions.

The exact event_type-to-application_role mapping is mandatory: CASH_ACCRUAL->CASH_BALANCE; DEBIT_ACCRUAL->DEBIT_BALANCE; COLLATERAL_ACCRUAL->COLLATERAL; COLLATERAL_TRANSFER->COLLATERAL; MARGIN_TRANSFER_CASH_LEG->CASH_BALANCE; TRADE_SETTLEMENT->TRADE_SETTLEMENT; INITIAL_MARGIN->INITIAL_MARGIN; MAINTENANCE_MARGIN->MAINTENANCE_MARGIN; VARIATION_MARGIN->VARIATION_MARGIN; FINAL_SETTLEMENT->FINAL_SETTLEMENT; FEES_TAX->NOT_APPLICABLE_FEE_TAX. Any other pair is INVALID. Every non-FEES_TAX event uses CASH_COLLATERAL_TERM pricing and the matching term-set role; every FEES_TAX event uses BROKER_FEE_TERM or TAX_LEVY_TERM pricing, has no cash-collateral pricing fields, and separately causes the required CASH_BALANCE applicability audit. TRADE_SETTLEMENT and FEES_TAX post only to CASH; DEBIT is permitted only for a nonnegative DEBIT_ACCRUAL posting.

Cash/collateral role-to-term mapping is mandatory: CASH_BALANCE->CASH_YIELD; DEBIT_BALANCE->DEBIT_FINANCING; COLLATERAL->COLLATERAL_YIELD; TRADE_SETTLEMENT->TRADE_SETTLEMENT_TRANSFER; INITIAL_MARGIN->INITIAL_MARGIN; MAINTENANCE_MARGIN->MAINTENANCE_MARGIN; VARIATION_MARGIN->VARIATION_MARGIN_TRANSFER; FINAL_SETTLEMENT->FINAL_SETTLEMENT_TRANSFER. Resolution matches route, account, currency, effective time and frozen priority CONTRACT, INSTRUMENT, INSTRUMENT_CATEGORY, ACCOUNT_WIDE. Exactly one highest-priority match is required; ACCOUNT_WIDE has null scope_value and applicable_instrument_category_or_contract_id. A duplicate, lower-priority override or missing required member is INVALID.

For every order and every execution_cash_margin_settlement_ledger_event, cash_collateral_role_applicability_audit has exactly one row for each frozen role. effective_at equals the parent decision/event time. REQUIRED maps to exactly one effective term-set member and NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_SOURCE_PROOF cites a route/contract/rule trace. A SUBMITTED order requires CASH_BALANCE and every triggered transaction, margin, funding, collateral and final-settlement role. Wrong route/account/currency/scope, missing role or unsupported not-applicable status is INVALID.

Each execution_fee_tax_component has exactly one component_type and exactly one currency; component_type is one of COMMISSION, EXCHANGE_FEE, CLEARING_FEE, OTHER_FEE, TAX or LEVY, never an aggregate. A fee component has exactly one dated broker_fee_term foreign key and null tax fields; a TAX or LEVY component has exactly one dated tax_levy_term and tax_jurisdiction foreign key and null broker-fee fields. term_calculated_amount/term_output_currency must equal the dated term calculation. If currency differs from term_output_currency, currency_conversion_required is true and exactly one frozen_fx_quote_conversion FK, rate, source, as-of, quote hash, basis and ROUND_HALF_EVEN precision are present; amount equals term_calculated_amount times that selected quote rate after its declared rounding. Otherwise all pre-event FX fields are null and amount/currency equal the term output identity. A PER_FILL component has non-null fill_id and maps via that fill's event link to exactly one FEES_TAX event. A PER_ORDER component has null fill_id and must carry order_level_exception_reference, order_level_source_reference, order_level_charge_at, order_level_allocation_rule_id and order_level_allocation_rule_sha256; its rule must allocate the exact dated-term amount/currency without double count. The event maps to exactly one component ID, amount and currency. The fee/tax component table, fill table, event table, cashflow/P&L table, normalized FX quote set and daily cash balance reconcile by explicit currency without a combined fee/tax amount or double count.

execution_feasibility_reservation proves every required context: every order has DECISION observations; every SUBMITTED order has SUBMISSION observations; every immutable fill has FILL observations with its exact fill_id. context_at equals the corresponding decision_at, submitted_at or fill_at and feasibility_observed_at is no later. Each row references effective broker terms and the typed pool snapshot key/time/unit/currency and global snapshot sequence in machine_validation_contract.reservation_pool_snapshot_contract. PASS requires 0 <= new_reservation_quantity_or_amount <= eligible_pool_balance_before - preexisting_active_reservation_quantity_or_amount, required equals new reservation and eligible_pool_balance_after >= 0. Its preexisting amount equals the ordered sum of all reservations active immediately before context, including a CONSUMED reservation active immediately before its FILL. A sell/close order has eligible lot and T+1 reservations whose available_to_sell_from is no later than the applicable submission/fill time; a buy/open order has cash buying-power and every triggered margin reservation. LOT pools reference exactly one lot per row and total active-before-context allocations for that lot cannot exceed eligible_to_sell_quantity. FAIL, INCOMPLETE or INVALID feasibility blocks the corresponding submission/fill and must take the frozen no-action/rejection path.

execution_fill_ledger_event_link is governed by machine_validation_contract.fill_event_link_allocation_rule: the event_type-to-link_role matrix is exact, every link currency equals its event currency, each linkable event has SUM(linked_amount) by event/currency exactly equal to event.amount and its fill_event_link_set_sha256 equals the ordered link set, while accrual-only event types have exactly zero links and the canonical empty-set hash. Per fill and allowed link role, allocations exactly reconcile to the stated principal, margin, final-settlement or fee/tax obligation; duplicate, underallocated or overallocated event/fill/role/currency tuples are INVALID.

Every event maps to exactly one daily_portfolio_ledger row; ORDER_LINKED additionally maps to one order and event_allocation_basis DIRECT_FILL additionally maps to one fill. Its event amount/currency, route/account, instrument/category, term or component foreign keys and effective time reconcile to the daily ledger, role audit, fill event-link set and portfolio_cashflow_pnl_ledger. component_origin_type and event_allocation_basis are mandatory discriminators: a FILL origin/direct-fill event has exactly one fill FK, while other declared origins/bases have null fill FK. The daily ledger's unitization_ledger_id, positions_lots_marks_sha256, cashflow_pnl_set_sha256 and reconciliation residual/matrix sets must equal the referenced normalized ledger sets. Orphan, ambiguous, wrong-currency or double-counted rows are INVALID.

portfolio_unitization_ledger performs all issue/redemption accounting: closing_units = opening_units + units_issued - units_redeemed; nav_after_external_cashflow equals daily total_nav; no external flow is represented as investment P&L; and unit_nav is positive whenever closing units are positive. portfolio_position_lot_mark_ledger keeps immutable lot origin, T+1 availability, economic_opening/economic_opened/economic_closed/economic_closing quantities, eligible_to_sell_quantity and active_sell_reservation_quantity. economic_closing_quantity = economic_opening_quantity + economic_quantity_opened - economic_quantity_closed; reservations reduce only available_to_sell_quantity = eligible_to_sell_quantity - active_sell_reservation_quantity, never economic quantity or marked_value/NAV. portfolio_cashflow_pnl_ledger uses one component/currency per row and reconciles its event/fill/lot links. replay_reconciliation_residual is generated from the signed machine_validation_contract.reconciliation_expected_matrix for every daily ledger: all mandatory cash, debit, collateral/margin, marked-position and unitization/NAV rows plus applicable FX, fill and fee/tax rows must exist once, with formula ID/hash and source-set hash. expected and actual row counts and ordered set hashes must match exactly; an empty or reduced residual set is INVALID. A residual is PASS only when actual - expected equals residual and absolute residual <= frozen tolerance in the same unit/currency; every non-PASS residual has an exception reference.

execution_order_state_transition is the execution-state table only: execution states are CREATED, SUBMITTED, PARTIAL, FILLED, PARTIAL_EXPIRED, PARTIAL_CANCELLED, NO_FILL, EXPIRED, CANCELLED, REJECTED, FAILED and NOT_SUBMITTED. Sequence is contiguous 1..N, first from_execution_state is CREATED, each later from_execution_state equals prior to_execution_state, transition_at is nondecreasing, every edge is in machine_validation_contract.execution_state_machine.allowed_edges and final to_execution_state equals execution_order_ledger.execution_state. execution_order_settlement_transition is a separate settlement-state table only: settlement states are exactly NOT_APPLICABLE, PENDING, PARTIALLY_SETTLED, SETTLED and FAILED. It follows its own contiguous matrix and final to_settlement_state equals execution_order_ledger.settlement_state. SETTLED is never an execution state; SUBMITTED, FAILED and CANCELLED are valid execution states; end-of-run disposition is never a settlement state.

For submission_path SUBMITTED, execution_side equals intended_execution_side, first execution edge is CREATED->SUBMITTED and submitted_at equals its transition time. For REJECTED_PRE_SUBMISSION, submitted_at is null, execution_side is NOT_SUBMITTED, quantities/fills are zero and first/only edge is CREATED->REJECTED. For NOT_SUBMITTED, submitted_at/rejected_at/filled_at/expires_at are null, execution_side is NOT_SUBMITTED, quantities/fills are zero and first/only edge is CREATED->NOT_SUBMITTED. Post-submission zero-fill operational failure uses SUBMITTED->FAILED with failed_at. Partial filled quantity is positive and below submitted quantity; later partial fills use PARTIAL->PARTIAL. Any partial operational failure/cancellation is PARTIAL->PARTIAL_CANCELLED with residual_disposition CANCELLED, cancelled_at and a failure/cancellation reason; PARTIAL->FAILED and PARTIAL->CANCELLED are forbidden. A residual is OPEN only with a retained order and later transition, otherwise terminally PARTIAL_EXPIRED or PARTIAL_CANCELLED. A side amendment is a new order ID.

Settlement normally begins NOT_APPLICABLE->PENDING and later reaches PARTIALLY_SETTLED, SETTLED or FAILED through the frozen settlement matrix. The only direct NOT_APPLICABLE->SETTLED edge is documented instantaneous clearing: transition_reason_code must be DOCUMENTED_INSTANTANEOUS_CLEARING, transition_at equals the positive fill_at, instantaneous_clearing_source_reference is present, and linked settlement events/source evidence exist. No carry/cancel/expiry label may appear in settlement_state or settlement transition fields.

At replay end, every order has one end_of_run_order_disposition. Any nonterminal CREATED, SUBMITTED or PARTIAL order is terminally CANCELLED_AT_RUN_END or EXPIRED_AT_RUN_END, unless CARRIED_WITH_OPENING_STATE is permitted by the signed end_of_run_carry_cancel_policy_sha256 and maps to a hash-bound next-run opening-state manifest. A carry has no unlinked result and cannot cross into a PRIMARY_HOLDOUT window. NO_OPEN_ORDER is required for terminal orders. Missing or implicit carry/cancel treatment is INVALID and cannot be represented as settlement state.

Every replay_candidate_endpoint_roster row has one endpoint and every replay_endpoint_result maps to one roster row. calendar_anchor_at is a, selected_start_valuation_at is s (the last eligible valuation at or before a), endpoint_end_valuation_at is e, s < e, elapsed_calendar_days is positive e-s, window_start equals s and window_end equals e. start/end daily-ledger and start/end unitization-ledger FKs resolve at s/e, and start/end_unit_nav equal the referenced portfolio_unitization_ledger.unit_nav. master_calendar_id/master_calendar_sha256 and candidate_generation_rule_id/hash match the signed parent and all roster/result/population rows; population evaluation_interval and raw_data_coverage fields match the signed parent and coverage must span the interval. annualized_net_twrr is recomputed under the hash-bound machine_validation_contract.endpoint_status_rule from direct unit NAV or the normalized ordered endpoint_unit_nav_chain_member set; total NAV ratio is forbidden where external flows exist. endpoint_status must equal the frozen precedence and 0.05 threshold classification, never a self-reported label. replay_endpoint_population_audit actual partition counts sum to actual candidate count; PASS/FAIL/INCOMPLETE/INVALID counts also sum exactly to actual candidate count; expected counts equal the signed freeze record; and every candidate appears exactly once. zero_candidate_status must be NOT_ZERO for PASS. Zero, shortfall, count/status mismatch, missing input hash or unmatched assignment is INCOMPLETE or INVALID, never PASS.

Each PRIMARY_HOLDOUT endpoint maps to one primary_holdout_start_state_manifest with integrity_status PASS, matching run binding/hash, primary_holdout_window_id, predicate audit and post-lockbox state origin. Its start_state_component_row_count and start_state_component_set_sha256 must equal the normalized primary_holdout_start_state_component membership rows. Each member uses a typed foreign key to the cited unitization, position-lot-mark, cashflow/P&L, reconciliation or other normalized state row, has post-lockbox provenance PASS and component integrity PASS, and reconciles to the manifest component hashes. OPEN_ORDER_TRANSITION_ROW must state order_id, state_transition_domain and state_transition_sequence and resolve exactly one execution or settlement transition; ROLL_DELIVERY_EXPIRY_PARAMETER_ROW must resolve exactly one frozen_roll_delivery_expiry_parameter_state. A pre-lockbox carry, hash-only unreferenced component, missing membership, failed component provenance/integrity, untyped transition/parameter target or unmatched row hash is CROSSING or INVALID and cannot be PRIMARY_HOLDOUT.

prospective_state_configuration_coverage_audit has exactly one configuration_tuple_sha256 row for every expected frozen parent class, route/term set, scope, role, material transaction, event, execution-model/tradability path, execution state, settlement state, residual path and end-of-run disposition. Only OBSERVED, ACCEPTED_CONSERVATIVE or SOURCE_PROVEN_NOT_APPLICABLE with evidence and PASS review may satisfy a required row. UNRESOLVED, FAILED, missing expected tuples or non-PASS review block replay admissibility and usable-strategy status.

Every monetary, price and quantity value has an explicit currency/unit or an exact dated-master foreign key. Cross-currency aggregation uses exactly one frozen_fx_quote_conversion row (or the exact same-currency identity rule), with source revision, observation time, rate and ROUND_HALF_EVEN precision; daily fx_quote_set_sha256 equals the ordered referenced quote set. No result is admissible unless every required FK, hash equality, state transition, reconciliation residual, endpoint population audit and prospective coverage row passes; otherwise endpoint_status is INCOMPLETE or INVALID and portfolio_q remains 0.

frozen_fx_quote_conversion is the only normalized FX source for portfolio_cashflow_pnl_ledger, execution_cash_margin_settlement_ledger_event and portfolio_position_lot_mark_ledger. Each nonidentity amount must equal source amount times its dated selected rate after declared rounding; identity must use rate one and no quote FK. Missing, stale, ambiguous or unbound FX evidence is INVALID, and a consumer may not use a daily-level summary source in place of its row-level quote.

master_calendar_daily_valuation_coverage generates exactly one row for every eligible master-calendar session across the raw-data/evaluation-warmup scope and every candidate s-to-e interior window. A COVERED row resolves exactly one daily ledger at its session; MISSING makes the scope INCOMPLETE and INVALID makes it INVALID. The generated count, covered count and canonical set hash bind the population audit and each candidate/result. A candidate cannot be ELIGIBLE or PASS unless both its endpoint window and global evaluation/warmup coverage status are PASS.

Every execution_cash_margin_settlement_ledger_event has exactly one signed balance_effect_bucket and exactly one linked portfolio_cashflow_pnl_ledger component; the component is evidence only for a bucketed event and cannot be added a second time. TRADE_SETTLEMENT and FEES_TAX route exactly once to CASH; DEBIT is reserved exclusively for a nonnegative DEBIT_ACCRUAL; collateral and margin events route exactly once to their prescribed buckets. The mandatory NAV_BRIDGE residual proves total_nav = cash - debit + collateral + margin + translated marked positions + signed unposted settlement residuals, where payables are negative and receivables positive, with pairwise-disjoint source sets. The unitization ledger must use this bridge as nav_before_external_cashflow and its frozen pre-flow unit-NAV method; a bridge, method, FX, event-routing or unitization failure is INVALID.

Every fill gross_notional is recomputed from fill_quantity, fill_price and the dated contract multiplier (ETF multiplier exactly one; futures multiplier resolves to the effective contract master) with the declared deterministic sign. Every linkable settlement/margin event has a selected formula ID/hash/input set: trade settlement derives from fill notional and dated terms, initial/maintenance margin derives from dated term basis and multiplier, and futures variation/final settlement derives from signed contracts times multiplier times the dated settlement-price change. Fill-event links reconcile to that calculated obligation, never an unconstrained event amount. Capacity and reservation prior balances include only rows strictly earlier by the declared chronological tuple (snapshot time, context/fill time, deterministic ID); a later row can never appear as prior consumption/reservation.
freeze_requirements: Bind the exact DD v8 SHA-256, machine_validation_contract.frozen_run_crosswalk required fields/equality map, and every replay_run_freeze_record field/hash to the canonical data-contract freeze record before any run-dependent row exists.

For each table, declare the raw-to-normalized mapping, transformation version, expected coverage, source-specific exception codes and canonical row/set hash algorithm before a replay result is viewed.

Freeze the endpoint roster/input hashes and expected counts, state matrices, carry/cancel policy, unitization/lot/P&L/reconciliation policy, fill/component policy, broker/tax policy and prospective coverage policy before first outcome view.
Any added, removed or reinterpreted column, enum value, primary key, FK, mapping or equation requires a new dictionary ID/version, new contract/rulebook compatibility review and new freeze record.

machine_validation_contract.json_object_key_uniqueness_rule: The canonical JSON parser must reject a document containing a duplicate object key at any nesting level; ordinary JSON parsers that silently retain a last duplicate key are not an acceptance parser.

hash_serialization_contract.canonical_encoding: Serialize as UTF-8 JSON with object keys sorted lexicographically, normalized scalar representation, explicit nulls where declared, and arrays in the table primary-key order or the named natural order before SHA-256.
hash_serialization_contract.universal_self_hash_exclusion_rule: Every field named *_sha256 that is a row, component, membership, manifest, calculation, event, fill, candidate, population, or set hash must hash its documented constituent fields while excluding that hash field itself. A self-referential hash serialization is invalid.

machine_validation_contract.primary_key_rule: Every primary_key member must be either a declared table column or a member of common_provenance_columns_apply_to_all_tables. All primary-key members are never null and their tuple is unique after supersession treatment.
machine_validation_contract.required_column_semantics: A primary-key column and every column whose null_policy is never_null, nonempty_array, positive_nonzero, decimal_ge_0, integer_ge_0, or a conditional never_null expression is required exactly as stated. A null-policy expression is executable contract text; a row failing it is rejected before reconciliation.
